expectationBasis: The visitor enters the username or verified email in “Username or email”, enters the correct password in “Password”, and clicks “Sign in”.

After successful authentication, the system stores a session with a unique session identifier, account identifier, and active status, then redirects to the workspace accessible to that user; the session remains valid after refreshing or reopening the workspace
the account menu displays the username
the session remains valid after refreshing or reopening the workspace

After successful sign-in, refreshing the workspace or directly reopening the previously accessible protected page still shows the signed-in user; after failed sign-in, refreshing or opening the visible protected page still requires authentication.

if authentication fails due to an unknown username/email, incorrect password, or unavailable account, the system displays exactly the same generic failure message “Invalid credentials”, does not disclose whether the account exists or which credential was wrong, and does not create a session.
An unknown account, incorrect password, or unavailable account all produce exactly the same generic failure message, remain on the sign-in page, and do not display the account menu.
after failed sign-in, refreshing or opening the visible protected page still requires authentication.
